1. Summary of the Primary business
a) Business Overview – Products and Services
We are a steel processing centre engaged in the business of converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products. Our core competencies include precision slitting, 
cut-to-length processing, shearing, and embossing of steel coils into slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks (collectively referred to as 
“Processed Steel Products”). We cater to a diversified customer base comprising Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs).
b) Description of industries served and typical customer/ clients of the Company

The market size of the Global Steel Processing Centre industry in India has grown at a CAGR of 8.6% from CY20 to CY25 reaching a market size of USD 8.2 billion by CY25. 
It is further projected to grow at a CAGR of 8.6% from CY26 to CY30, reaching a market size of USD 12.4 billion by CY30. India's steel service industry is set for substantial 
growth, fuelled by rapid industrialisation, particularly in manufacturing and construction. The rising demand for steel in sectors like automotive, infrastructure, engineering, and 
machinery is driving the need for efficient distribution and processing. Government-led infrastructure investment and expanding manufacturing activity are expected to further support 
demand. The adoption of just-in-time inventory practices by manufacturers is also fuelling the growth of Steel Processing Centres, enabling faster and more customised solutions. 
Increasing investment in automation, digital inventory management and advanced processing capabilities is expected to further strengthen the sector.

by our Company in the year 2021. He oversees functions such as administration, strategic leadership and business development, market expansion 
and contributing to overall growth of our Company.
Nitin Vijaykumar Gupta Nitin Vijaykumar Gupta is the Promoter and Managing Director of our Company and has been a Director since its incorporation. He holds a
